text:
elaine: VoltEdge asked for a tight perf/W + throughput benchmark for the marketplace listing. They want reproducible numbers + an embargoed figure pack for a co-blog. Can we run next week?

sam: Do we have partner VPN + perfmon access yet? Also how many rigs and what model shapes?

alex-voltedge: I can open VPN and perfmon on rigs alpha/beta by Tue EOD. We have 3 identical nodes (A/B/C) in their colo.

kevin: Proposed matrix: model=redwood-mini (seq 512, 2048), modes=fp16,int8,q4_0; kernels=stock,fused-attn,cublas-tuned. Include powercap values: 250W, 200W, 150W for perf/W curves. Also KV-cache thrash and sustained-run.

maria: Telemetry minimal set: run_id, ts, host_pdu_w (1s), socket_w, gpu_power_w, p50/p95/p99 latency, ipc, l2_miss, kernel_dmesg snippet. We'll aggregate CSVs + PNG heatmaps.

elaine: Owners: Sam=bench ops, Kevin=kernel tuning, Maria=telemetry/analysis, Elaine=PM/announce. Legal-bot watches raw-dump requests. Agreed?

sam: Agreed. I'll do a dry-run Wed and full sweep Thu if VPN is ready. Need partner to allow perfmon and kernel debug symbols.

bench-bot: Scheduled run created: id=bench-1745556666 start=1745630400. Tests queued: baseline,int8,q4_0.

kevin: Driver stack to pin in logs: nvidia-driver 535.86 / CUDA 12.1 / cuBLAS 12.1. If partner cannot change, we will document compatibility rows. Also plan to try ATT_FUSE=1 and CUBLAS_TUNE=2 knobs.

alex-voltedge: We can match stack on A/B; C is older driver (will still run, will note in matrix). VPN and perfmon will be enabled Tue morning. granting write to s3 bucket after NDA check.

maria: Proposed telemetry JSON schema (for onboarding):
```json
{"run_id":"bench-1745556666","ts":1745556666,"host_pdu_w":230.4,"socket_w":[115.2,115.0],"gpu_power_w":208.7,"latency_ms":{"p50":10.2,"p95":45.1,"p99":89.3},"counters":{"ipc":0.78,"l2_miss":0.012},"notes":"driver=535.86,cuda=12.1"}
```

elaine: Legal note: partner requested raw traces for their validation. Legal-bot: can you flag if NDA addendum is required?

legal-bot: Raw kernel traces considered sensitive. NDA addendum recommended for raw dumps; aggregated CSVs and plots are fine to share without addendum. I'll start the request.

sam: Runner snippet for bench ops:
```bash
run-bench --model redwood-mini --seq 2048 --modes fp16,int8,q4_0 \
  --dur 3600 --powercaps 250,200,150 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-voltedge/bench-1745556666 \
  --rigs A,B,C
```

kevin: Add a quality regression hook: compute token logprob delta and sample diffs. Flag anything >0.6 drop for manual review.

maria: Bucket for artifacts: s3://redwood-partner-voltedge/bench-1745556666. We'll grant aggregated-read to voltedge-marketing; raw-trace write pending NDA.

elaine: Timeline: Tue partner enables VPN; Wed dry-run; Thu tuning + iter; Fri final sweep. Partner wants embargoed figures by Mon next week for their comms. Can we ship that?

kevin: We can get numbers by Mon if tuning doesn't hit regressions. Add one extra day buffer.

sam: Action items: 1) Alex to confirm VPN + perfmon Tue morning. 2) Bench ops to prep harness + dashboard. 3) Kernel team to provide knobs and safe defaults. 4) Maria to create telemetry bucket and perms. 5) Elaine to open NDA addendum with Legal. 6) Marketing draft for co-blog.

alex-voltedge: Will confirm VPN + perfmon Tue AM and start NDA flow for raw traces. Looking forward to the run.

elaine: Thanks all 44aa! I'll send kickoff note and keep the channel updated.
